fields.Name: IT152 - Ciphertext at Rest in the RunView Cache
fields.Description: A MJ: Credentials row with an encrypted Values field is read through RunView with a run-unique filter and the raw RunViewCache entry is inspected. CT0 the table column holds ciphertext; CT1 the miss returns plaintext and writes the cache; CT2 the cached entry holds ciphertext only; CT3 the hit returns plaintext without rewriting the cache; CT4 an entity_object result also decrypts. Mutating; self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The cache never holds plaintext for an encrypted field while every caller-facing path returns plaintext.
